CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 12.01.2022 in LAC No.24/2018.
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 283 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. NC: 2024:KHC-K:9856 V.R. Kalliyanikutty, the appeal is dismissed as time- barred, without addressing the merits.
